usedFor: ChatBotKit holds the datasets a chatbot answers from, and “Add Dataset Record” keeps that knowledge up to date.

bestTemplate.name: “Add Dataset Record” in ChatBotKit
bestTemplate.why: It adds a text record to a chosen dataset, so the chatbot can answer from new information.

watchOut: “Delete Dataset” in ChatBotKit removes a whole dataset, so be sure the right one is chosen.
